metadata.description: A dense red-hazard labyrinth with cyan stepped dividers, corner recesses and central U-shaped bays. Cyan walls block movement and do not close a cut. Red ground is lethal until captured. Six purple bouncers threaten unfinished lines; two cyan patrols travel the outer safe rail. Start at bottom center, move sideways out of the bay, and find a clear entry before cutting. Reveal 75%. Layout follows the supplied screenshot; tile scaling and enemy motion use existing Classic rules.
